card.name: Ernst and ergot-name pieces
card.fires_on: The name Ernst, the end of German-style surnames like Arndt, and the middle of ergot drug names such as ergonovine. Also fires on a few other partial proper names.

modes.label: Ernst as a first name
modes.description: The first name Ernst before a German surname.
modes.example: Hitler installed former SA leader,<< Ernst>> Röhm, as the new leader

modes.label: Inside ergot drug names
modes.description: Middle of ergonovine or methylergonovine in ergot derivative lists.
modes.example: Ergot derivatives: Dihydroergotamine, erg<<on>>ovine, ergotamine, meth

modes.label: Partway through personal names
modes.description: Closing or middle pieces of surnames and names like Arndt or Ernesto.
modes.example: Dr Jairo Ernest<<o>> Luna, who worked on the CIIF

card.writes: It seems to push toward name continuations such as Ernst-type or foreign names, but the effect is mixed.
card.plain: It lights up on the name Ernst and on pieces in the middle of ergot drug names and foreign surnames.
